Covers 5 use cases: ① Understanding what the Bible says about heaven — ("what is heaven like" "Bible verses about heaven") ② Finding comfort in grief or loss — ("comfort for losing a loved one" "will I see them in heaven") ③ Exploring theological questions about the afterlife — ("what will we do in heaven" "will we recognize each other") ④ Strengthening personal faith and hope — ("hope of heaven" "eternal perspective" "encouragement") ⑤ Answering skeptical questions about heaven — ("is heaven real" "why does God allow suffering" "theodicy") Trigger when users say: "heaven" "afterlife" "what happens when we die" "new earth" "eternity" "will I see my loved ones" "what is heaven like" "Carl Martin" "heavenly" "paradise" "eternal life" "resurrection" "new Jerusalem" "kingdom of God" "blessed hope" Also triggers when the user says they just installed this skill or doesn't know how to start.
